text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 60

An all-male panel does not prove bias on its own, but alongside the substantial experience gap and the lack of response, unconscious bias or affinity bias may have influenced how subjective qualities like "client relationships" were evaluated. 

Raising the panel’s gender composition directly right now is likely to trigger defensiveness and close off productive communication. Instead, follow up firmly on your request for written, criteria-based feedback. If the firm refuses transparency or you choose to pursue a formal grievance or legal counsel, the panel composition, the disparity in objective qualifications, and the procedural silence will form relevant supporting evidence rather than a standalone argument.
